items.title: Summit Therapeutics Signs Agreement to Sell Phase III Asset Ridinilazole to Biossil, Inc.
items.summary: Summit Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ: SMMT) today announced it has signed an agreement with Toronto-based Biossil, Inc. for the sale of ridinilazole, an investigational Phase III precision antibiotic owned by Summit. Biossil is an artificial intelligence (AI)-native biopharma company focused on advancing late-stage programs in life-threatening indications with urgent unmet medical needs. Previously, ridinilazole was evaluated in Summit’s Phase III Ri-CoDIFy study for the treatment of patients suffering from C. difficile infection ( C. diff. infection or CDI), an area of high unmet need. The study showed that ridinilazole resulted in a higher observed Sustained Clinical Response (SCR) rate than vancomycin but did not meet the study’s primary endpoint for superiority within the established time boundaries.
